description: This file defines a custom event handler class for Vuforia augmented reality tracking in Unity. It manages tracking state changes by enabling or disabling rendering components, colliders, and UI canvases based on whether the trackable object is detected.

classes.name: DefaultTrackableEventHandler
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class implementing Vuforia's ITrackableEventHandler interface to respond to changes in AR target tracking status.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the TrackableBehaviour component and registers the event handler.

methods.name: OnTrackableStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the tracking state, triggering appropriate UI and rendering updates.

methods.name: OnTrackingFound
methods.description: Enables rendering, colliders, and canvases when the AR object is detected.

methods.name: OnTrackingLost
methods.description: Disables rendering, colliders, and canvases when the AR object is lost.
